name: forge-agent-cli
description: forge ∞ — autonomous software engineering intelligence. Zero dependencies, pure Node, direct-to-provider. v98 shipwise (the delivery release: TIER-3 STRUCTURED EXTRACTION is finally WIRED — langstruct.js enriches the shared index through one session-cached LSP pass per server with honest per-file fallbacks, records carry symbolDetails + extraction provenance {layer, source}, JSON gets a genuine layer-1 native parse (JSON.parse, top-level keys), INDEX_VERSION bumps once so lexical-era caches can never masquerade as structured, extractOne reuses fresh records so enrichment SURVIVES the next world rebuild, and the world model serves symbolDetails to every consumer; VERIFIED GIT DELIVERY — gitship.js is kernel policy (never a tool): after the 9-check completion gate says ok, the run's verified files are committed with forge trailers on an explicit pathspec (never -A, .forge/** never ships), foreign dirty files are named and never staged, identity falls back per-invocation (repo config never written), branch:auto BOOKMARKS forge/<task-id> without a checkout, push is explicit+consent only and force never, a PR-ready text artifact is rendered, all OFF by default and the gitship section is PRIVILEGED so a checked-in project config can never turn delivery on; PROMPT-INJECTION DEFENSE — every tool result enters the conversation through a constant attribution fence with an advisory injection-marker scan (override attempts, role spoofing, identity rewrites, exfiltration prompts, policy disarming — detected and surfaced, never fatal), the data-not-instructions rule rides BOTH system prompts, and the fence is a privileged user-only switch; WORLD MODEL AT SCALE — the documented 0=unlimited ceiling is finally reachable (the resolver destroyed Infinity), extractOne batches index writes (was quadratic), expand/locate reuse their walk, buildAsync walks CHUNKED with in-flight promise sharing + a short fresh window so six-figure repos never freeze the loop, and persistedRecords reads the last recorded truth (the CONTRACT_DRIFT before-capture bug — pre-mutation contracts were actually post-mutation); ARTIFACT EVIDENCE — observed build outputs (dist/APK/target) are first-class ledger evidence, adapter-gated and never invented, and the declared runtimeValidation flag is finally ENFORCED at critical risk; BROWSER VISUAL REGRESSION — visual_diff baselines (snapshot text diff + screenshot hash) with evidence-phrased verdicts and full-page capture) on v95 worktreewise.
